headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis. Lourdes Gurriel Jr. is on the 10-day injured list with a right adductor strain, while Jeff Criswell is out with a right shoulder strain. Oneil Cruz has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures.

The Chicago Cubs made a notable trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. The Athletics also traded Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, while the St. Louis Cardinals acquired Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Travis Bazzana led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall to Phillies in Dominant 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies took control of the game early, ultimately securing a 6-1 victory over the New York Mets. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies to victory with a strong 5.0 innings pitched, striking out 7 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Justin Sterner on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis. The injury occurred on July 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale in a trade with the Athletics. Civale joins the Cubs after being dealt for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
